thread:
Mike: Quick sync — need to finalize obs slice for Q2 release. Focus: dashboards + trace hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics. Can we pick priorities and must-haves? cc @Asha @Devon
Asha: For launch must-haves: per-route latency (p50/p95/p99), token-level cost breakdown, and error aggregation by model+route. UI: top-level heatmap + route detail panel.
Devon: Trace hooks: need distributed trace id propagation, span for model inference (tokenize->infer->postprocess). Sampling + metadata tags (model, quantization, seq_len).
Sam: Cost idea — 'hotpath' bucket that attributes GPU time to routes; per-token cost + amortized cache savings. Also need cost drilldown to customer-facing features.
Mike: Proposal: traces sampled at 1% by default, errors sampled at 10%, retention tiered (7d free, 30d paid). Customers can opt into higher sampling on Dedicated/Private.
Asha: Agree. Add acceptance criteria: 'Cost UI surfaces top 5 routes responsible for 80% GPU spend', and 'Trace hooks annotate KV-cache evictions'.
Devon: Small FYI — adding KV-cache annotations requires a lightweight runtime hook; I'll note perf impact in spec. Could be opt-in in alpha.
Sam: Action items: Devon to draft trace-hook spec by EOD Fri; Mike to prepare a short demo for sales (next Tue); Asha to update roadmap and acceptance criteria.
Mike: Noted. @deploy-bot creating ticket now.
deploy-bot: INF-3124 created: Trace hooks + cost attribution epic — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3124
Asha: Can we mark auto-fallback to smaller model variant on cost spike as a stretch goal (M2)? Rollout criteria: QA pass, perf within 10% SLA, signal-based canary.
Devon: Ack — will include auto-fallback notes in the spec as M2.
Mike: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate and put a short decision summary in the roadmap doc. :thumbsup:
